# Make a fair volunteer schedule in a few minutes

> Free volunteer shift scheduler for churches, PTAs, food banks and youth sports. Paste your volunteers with the days they can do and their maximum shifts, list the shifts, and get a fair roster with unfilled slots flagged. CSV, calendar and reminder exports. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
